_note: Written by six writer agents from the abstracts alone, blind to the runs, every system's output and the q1p set, checked by check_q3.py and frozen before any system ran on it. Held out for validating changes made after the first comparison results; nobody designing a change reads it.
rule: One question per q1 PEP, written from the PEP's abstract (or its first section when it has none) as a developer who needs that PEP would ask it, in their own words. English; 6 to 22 words; never the word PEP or any PEP number; no run of 5 or more words copied from the abstract; content-word overlap with the title (the q1p measure) below 0.5; not shaped toward any search method.
